compatible_result_applied.claim: QFORM-MULTIPIVOT-BILINEAR-SMALLBALL-v1 plus exact curved-2x2 logarithmic counterexample

new_result.statement: If disjoint original-coordinate I,J have equal size m>=3 and B=A[I,J] is invertible, then arbitrary within-block curvature, signs, outside couplings and independent coordinate densities <=1 satisfy ||p_{X^TAX}||_infinity <= m/(m-2)|det B|^{-1/m}; the density is continuous and vanishes at infinity.
new_result.proof_core: Condition outside I union J; absorb same-side terms into unit-modulus L2 amplitudes; Plancherel on 2u^TBv gives |phi(t)| <= min(1,pi^(m/2)|t|^(-m/2)|det B|^(-1/2)); integrate exactly.
